# HOI4 Portrait Workflows 3.1.0

This package contains four compact ComfyUI workflows for the distilled
FLUX.2 Klein 9B model and the tuned step-2500 HOI4 portrait LoRA.

## Included

- source-reference workflow with three candidates;
- text-to-image workflow with the exact example prompt;
- RealESRGAN + exact Adonis Base → Refine processing workflow;
- sequential folder-batch workflow with one sampler;
- live advanced sampler cards;
- centered 1024×1365 and 156×210 PNG output;
- 156×210 DXT5 DDS output with no mipmaps;
- VRAM-guided full, FP8, and GGUF installation paths;
- pinned custom-node and model revisions.

## Storage

The shared support set is 11.966 GB. Exact complete model payloads are:

- full: 30.124 GB;
- FP8: 21.399 GB;
- GGUF Q4_K_M: 17.876 GB;
- GGUF Q5_K_M: 18.985 GB;
- GGUF Q6_K: 19.832 GB;
- GGUF Q8_0: 21.945 GB.

The Windows x64 executable installs into an existing ComfyUI. The RunPod
archive defaults to full distilled and accepts explicit `--variant` and
`--gguf-quants` selections.
